2577-5670-5933.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-5933.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

579-3360-3755.description:
Activate Torchling by tapping it, adding {R}{R} due to Mana Reflection
Activate Torchling by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat.

240-728-5470-7060.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-5470-7060.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1170-5131-6495-7052--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6495-7052--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Savvy Trader.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-5131-6495-7052--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4802-5641-6854.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

560-997-4550-7920.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-997-4550-7920.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1322-3259-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

624-670-1619-3734.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
624-670-1619-3734.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Phantasmal Image and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
624-670-1619-3734.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2267-3240-6462-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Tormod triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

147-2511-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-2511-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {3}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-3992-5997.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Iraxxa
1618-2440-3992-5997.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Cyclical Evolution.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.
1618-2440-3992-5997.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Iraxxa. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

1491-2113-6218-7315.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3986-7296.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
3259-3986-7296.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1409-2933-4742-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1409-2933-4742-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

273-3771-7070.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Shuko ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying at most {2} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
273-3771-7070.notes: The starting cost can be reduced depending on the number of +1/+1 counters on Animar.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Dryad of the Ilysian Grove

280-4572-5478-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
280-4572-5478-5702.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters untapped due to Spelunking, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1358-2073-4659-4720--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the mana value 1 artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sydri's first ability by paying {U}, causing the artifact to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact, adding {C}{C}.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat.

413-4681-6132.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, with the Karmic Guide trigger targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, with the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger targeting Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat form step 2.

2079-2457-4289-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

372-1309-2955.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Salvager of Secrets exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
372-1309-2955.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Salvager of Secrets and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Salvager of Secrets trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Salvager of Secrets and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1992-2646-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1992-2646-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Basri's Lieutenant's second ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Repeat.

1080-1880-4899.manaNeeded: {G/U}, plus enough mana to cast the kicker spell kicked
1080-1880-4899.notablePrerequisites: You have a card in hand with kicker or multikicker.
1080-1880-4899.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer by paying {0}, exling the top card of your library and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Phyrexian Devourer equal to that card's mana value.
If Phyrexian Devourer's power becomes seven or greater this way, it triggers.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1 until you have an empty library.
With the Phyrexian Devourer triggers on the stack, cast Bioshift by paying {G/U}, moving all +1/+1 counters from Phyrexian Devourer onto Hallar.
Resolve all Phyrexian Devourer triggers from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it.
Cast any kicker or multikicker spell with kicker by paying its mana cost plus its kicker cost.
Hallar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself, then dealing damage equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on it to each opponent.

3090-3903-3958.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying {2}{R}, giving control of Moderation to an opponent.
Cast Knowledge Pool by paying {6}.
Whenever the opponent that controls Moderation casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Moderation prevents the opponent from casting more than one spell each turn, the opponent cannot cast the spell permitted by Knowledge Pool, or any other spell that turn.

193-1543-2247.notablePrerequisites:
Teferi has at least eight loyalty counters on it.
You control at least three additional planeswalkers.
193-1543-2247.description:
Activate a planeswalker you control by putting zero loyalty counters on it, putting a loyalty counter on each planeswalker you control.
Repeat step 1 two additional times.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Teferi.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Repeat step 1 three additional times.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

2314-4052-4067.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
"Drake" chosen with Kindred Discovery.
2314-4052-4067.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, targeting a mana-producing permanent.
Drake Haven triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 2/2 Drake creature token.
When the Drake enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Mind over Matter ability from step 2, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.

614-914-1235.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
614-914-1235.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist and Nucklavee with haste.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Nucklavee trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2397-3821-3859.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{B}.
2397-3821-3859.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping the five lands.
Activate the five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping the five lands.
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying {U}{B}.
Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning Cavern Harpy and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1061-1869-4428.notablePrerequisites: You have the city's blessing and/or control ten or more permanents.
1061-1869-4428.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Timestream Navigator.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator's Ascend ability gives you the city's blessing.
When Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Inalla, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1295-3093.easyPrerequisites: No two cards in library share a name.
1295-3093.description:
Cast Tainted Pact by paying {1}{B}, exiling your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

1463-2199-2836.description:
Activate Frenetic Efreet's ability an arbitrarily large amount of times by paying a total of {0}.
Resolve the first Frenetic Efreet ability, flipping a coin and either sacrificing Frenetic Efreet or causing it to phase out.
If you win the flip, Zndrsplt triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the next Frenetic Efreet ability, flipping a coin and not phasing out or sacrificing Frenetic Efreet due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3 until you have no cards in library.
Draw a card, causing you to win the game due to Laboratory Maniac

2615-3799-4150.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
2615-3799-4150.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, targeting your opponent and setting their life total to 13.
Cast Shivan Meteor, dealing 13 damage to Stuffy Doll.
Stuffy Doll triggers, dealing 13 damage to your opponent.
